title: A2 reading check
goal: Show that you can understand everyday documents (a notice, a work email, an activity program, a personal story and a text exchange) and find the main point and the key details.

example.fr: Il y a un avis dans l'ascenseur.
example.en: There's a notice in the elevator.

example.fr: La réunion est déplacée à mercredi.
example.en: The meeting is moved to Wednesday.

example.fr: La date limite, c'est le 19 janvier.

blocks.title: A2 reading: what you can do
blocks.body:
At A2, a reader can understand **short, simple texts on familiar topics**: notices, personal emails and letters, programs, ads, short stories about everyday life. You can find **specific information**, follow **what happened and in what order**, and understand **why** someone writes.

This check has **5 documents** and **14 questions**:

- a notice in an apartment building
- an email from a manager to her team
- a community centre's winter program
- a newcomer's blog post about her first winter
- a text exchange about a used sofa

The answers are always **in the text**, but often with **different words**: the right option usually *rephrases* the document instead of copying it. Aim for **80%** (12 of 14) to pass the checkpoint.

**Strategy:** read the question first, then find the part of the document it's about. Watch the small words that change the meaning: [[ne… plus]] (no longer), [[mais]], [[au lieu de]] (instead of), [[avant]], [[non fourni]] (not provided). Give yourself about **one minute per question** here. (In the real TEF and TCF reading tests, documents are longer and you have about 90 seconds per question.)

steps.title: Part 1: A notice, an email and a program
steps.intro: Three practical documents. Look for dates, times, changes and conditions.

blocks.title: Document 1: A notice in the lobby
blocks.fr:
AVIS AUX LOCATAIRES
Immeuble du 2250, rue Beaubien

Mardi 14 novembre, de 9 h à 15 h, il y aura une coupure d'eau dans tout l'immeuble : le plombier va remplacer des tuyaux au sous-sol. Pensez à garder de l'eau pour boire et pour cuisiner.

À partir du 20 novembre, la collecte du recyclage sera le jeudi. Il n'y aura plus de collecte le lundi.

Merci de votre compréhension.
La gestion de l'immeuble

blocks.prompt: What will happen on Tuesday, November 14?
options: There will be no water in the building from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
The plumber will visit each apartment from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
There will be no water in the basement only, all day
blocks.explain: [[Une coupure d'eau dans tout l'immeuble]], [[de 9 h à 15 h]]. The plumber works in the basement ([[au sous-sol]]), but the water is off everywhere.
optionFeedback: The plumber works [[au sous-sol]] (in the basement), not in the apartments.
[[Dans tout l'immeuble]] = in the whole building, and only [[de 9 h à 15 h]].

options: Recycling will be collected on Thursdays instead of Mondays
Recycling will be collected on Mondays and Thursdays
There will be no more recycling collection
blocks.explain: [[La collecte du recyclage sera le jeudi. Il n'y aura plus de collecte le lundi.]] = on Thursdays, and no longer on Mondays. [[Ne… plus]] means *no longer*.

blocks.title: Document 2: An email to the clinic staff
blocks.fr:
Objet : Horaire des Fêtes et réunion d'équipe

Bonjour à tous,

La clinique sera fermée le 25 et le 26 décembre, ainsi que le 1er janvier. Le 24 et le 31 décembre, nous fermerons plus tôt, à 13 h.

Attention, changement : notre réunion d'équipe ne sera pas le lundi 18 décembre, mais le mercredi 20 décembre, à 8 h 30, dans la salle de pause. Le café et les croissants seront offerts !

Enfin, si vous voulez prendre des vacances en janvier, envoyez-moi vos dates avant le 15 décembre.

Merci et bonne semaine,
Julie Gagnon, directrice

blocks.prompt: What happens at the clinic on December 24?
options: It is open, but it closes early, at 1 p.m.
It is closed all day
It is open, and there is a team meeting at 1 p.m.
blocks.explain: [[Le 24 et le 31 décembre, nous fermerons plus tôt, à 13 h]]: open, but closing early. The clinic is closed on the 25th, the 26th and January 1.

blocks.prompt: When is the team meeting now?
options: Wednesday, December 20, at 8:30 a.m.
Monday, December 18, at 8:30 a.m.
Wednesday, December 18, at 1 p.m.
blocks.explain: [[Ne sera pas le lundi 18 décembre, mais le mercredi 20 décembre, à 8 h 30]]: moved to Wednesday the 20th. Monday the 18th was the old date.

blocks.prompt: What must employees do before December 15?
options: Send their vacation dates for January, if they want time off
Bring coffee and croissants to the meeting
Tell Julie if they can work on December 25
blocks.explain: [[Si vous voulez prendre des vacances en janvier, envoyez-moi vos dates avant le 15 décembre.]] The coffee and croissants are offered by the clinic ([[seront offerts]]).

blocks.title: Document 3: A winter program
blocks.fr:
CENTRE COMMUNAUTAIRE DU PLATEAU, programme d'hiver

Conversation française (adultes, niveau débutant) : le mardi, de 18 h 30 à 20 h. Gratuit.
Cuisine du monde (adultes) : le samedi, de 10 h à 12 h. 15 $ par cours, ingrédients compris.
Yoga doux (55 ans et plus) : le lundi et le jeudi, de 9 h à 10 h. 60 $ pour la session.
Patinage pour enfants (5 à 10 ans) : le dimanche, de 13 h à 14 h. 40 $ pour la session. Patins non fournis : apportez vos patins.

Inscriptions au comptoir d'accueil, du 8 au 19 janvier. Places limitées !

blocks.prompt: Raj is 32. He works during the day and wants a free activity. Which one is for him?
options: French conversation
World cooking
Gentle yoga
blocks.explain: [[Conversation française]] is for adults, in the evening ([[de 18 h 30 à 20 h]]) and [[gratuit]] (free). Cooking costs 15 $; yoga is for people aged 55 and over, in the morning.

blocks.prompt: Karim wants to sign up his 7-year-old daughter for skating. What does he need to know?
options: He has to bring skates for her
Skates are included in the price
The class is on Saturday morning
blocks.explain: [[Patins non fournis : apportez vos patins]] = skates not provided, bring your skates. The class is on Sunday, from 13 h to 14 h.

options: In person at the front desk, between January 8 and 19
By email, before January 8
At the first class
blocks.explain: [[Inscriptions au comptoir d'accueil, du 8 au 19 janvier]]: at the reception desk, from the 8th to the 19th. [[Places limitées]] = limited spots, so don't wait.

steps.title: Part 2: A story and a text exchange
steps.intro: Now follow a story in the past, then a conversation. Pay attention to who does what, and why.

blocks.title: Document 4: Sofia's blog
blocks.fr:
Mon premier hiver à Québec

Quand je suis arrivée à Québec en novembre dernier, je ne connaissais pas la ville et je n'avais pas de vrai manteau d'hiver. Le premier matin de neige, il faisait moins vingt. J'ai mis trois chandails, mais j'avais quand même froid !

À l'arrêt d'autobus, ma voisine, Madame Bouchard, a vu que je tremblais. Elle m'a proposé un chocolat chaud chez elle, et elle m'a expliqué comment m'habiller : une tuque, des mitaines et de bonnes bottes. Le samedi suivant, nous sommes allées ensemble au magasin et j'ai enfin acheté un vrai manteau.

Maintenant, j'adore l'hiver : je fais du patin tous les dimanches sur les plaines d'Abraham. L'année prochaine, j'apprendrai le ski de fond !

Sofia

blocks.prompt: What was Sofia's problem when she arrived?
options: She didn't have the right clothes for the cold
She couldn't find an apartment
She didn't like the snow
blocks.explain: [[Je n'avais pas de vrai manteau d'hiver]] and [[j'avais quand même froid]] (I was still cold) even with three sweaters ([[chandails]], the Québec word).

blocks.prompt: How did Madame Bouchard help her?
options: She invited her for a hot chocolate and explained how to dress for winter
She drove her to work every morning
She gave her an old winter coat
blocks.explain: [[Elle m'a proposé un chocolat chaud chez elle]] and [[elle m'a expliqué comment m'habiller]]. Then they went to the store together, where Sofia bought her own coat.
optionFeedback: They met at the bus stop ([[l'arrêt d'autobus]]); nothing about driving.
Sofia bought a coat herself: [[j'ai enfin acheté un vrai manteau]].

blocks.prompt: How does Sofia feel about winter now?
options: She loves it, and she goes skating every Sunday
She still finds it too cold
She likes it, but only in the city
blocks.explain: [[Maintenant, j'adore l'hiver]] and [[je fais du patin tous les dimanches]]. The story moves from imparfait (then) to present (now).

blocks.prompt: What is her plan for next year?
options: To learn cross-country skiing
To teach skating
To go back to Mexico in winter
blocks.explain: [[L'année prochaine, j'apprendrai le ski de fond]]: futur simple of [[apprendre]]. [[Le ski de fond]] = cross-country skiing.

blocks.title: Document 5: Messages about a used sofa
blocks.fr:
Alex : Bonjour, votre divan est toujours disponible ?
Madame Côté : Bonjour ! Oui, il est toujours disponible. Il est en très bon état, mais il y a une petite tache sur un coussin. C'est pour ça que je le vends 150 $ au lieu de 300 $.
Alex : Parfait. Je peux passer le chercher samedi ?
Madame Côté : Samedi, je ne suis pas là. Dimanche après 14 h, ça vous va ? Attention : l'appartement est au troisième étage, sans ascenseur. Venez avec un ami !
Alex : D'accord, dimanche à 15 h. Merci !

blocks.prompt: Why is the sofa cheaper than its usual price?
options: There is a small stain on one cushion
It is very old
Madame Côté has to move on Saturday
blocks.explain: [[Il y a une petite tache sur un coussin. C'est pour ça que…]] = that's why. [[Au lieu de 300 $]] = instead of $300. ([[Divan]] is common in Québec; in France, [[canapé]].)

blocks.prompt: Why does Madame Côté say “Venez avec un ami”?
options: The apartment is on the third floor and there's no elevator
She wants to meet Alex's friend
The sofa is in a store far away
blocks.explain: [[Au troisième étage, sans ascenseur]]: Alex will need help to carry the sofa down the stairs.

summary:
- Find dates, times, changes and conditions in notices, work emails and programs: [[ne… plus]], [[pas… mais…]], [[non fournis]], [[avant le 15 décembre]]
- Follow a short story told in the past, and tell the background (imparfait) from the events (passé composé)
- Understand why someone writes, and rephrased answers, as in TEF and TCF reading questions

meta.author: ai
meta.notes: Rewrote three test-critical sentences that relied on untaught or misleading forms (et non plus, est déplacée au, patins non fournis alone) so each item is answerable at A2. Rewrote r3, which assumed facts not in the text. Corrected the claim about TEF/TCF timing per question (about 90 s, not 1 min).
